Cronos: Lazarus - Gameplay Teaser | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011556/

Survival is no longer enough.

Watch the first gameplay teaser for Cronos: Lazarus, the upcoming DLC for Cronos: The New Dawn.

Step into the role of the Pathfinder,  the younger version of the fan-favorite Warden, and experience a new chapter of the Cronos universe built around faster action, tactical abilities, and relentless pursuit.

Master new powers, including teleportation and decoy tactics, wield the deadly Gladius, and face a new threat sent by the Collective with one purpose: to hunt you down.

Cronos: Lazarus is scheduled for release in Fall 2026 and will be available on PlayStation 5.

Learn more and wishlist now!

Defy the calling. Bring her back.

Neverness to Everness (NTE) - Ver.1.2 Character Trailer: Shinku | PS5 Games
https://www.playstation.com/games/nte-neverness-to-everness/

NTE V1.2 "999 Nights" launches July 8 with new limited S-Class Character Shinku.

Shinku can come across as hard to approach day to day. But when out on a mission, she proves herself dependable far beyond her years. She's always the first to charge into danger and shield her teammates. That's just how this awkward dragon girl protects the people she cares about. As for social skills... well, she might need a little more time to find her footing there.

Ready to Roll? Step into a medieval-themed fantasy world of DSD's new tabletop game, free S-Class selector, up to 19 new outfits and brand-new maps include volcano, ice field, lakelands, and the Dragon Keep to explore.
